description: A Mechatronics Freshman in AASTMT interested in software , hardware , data analysis and design looking forward to learn more and expand my skillsets
summary:
I developed a program that analysis the basic vitals of astronaut in a mission.
It analysis Blood pressure , heart rate , respiratory rate , blood sugar ,blood oxygen and sleep.
Made a risk point system that gives points according to how abnormal the state of the astronaut it.
Integrated octave to be able to graph the data and compare it to old data which help in analyzing trends and predict future changes.
details:
The program works by saving the vitals of the astronaut in a given day in a .CSV file which acts as a spread sheet which is used to compare between the old data and the data provided by the astronaut in the future, the program calculates the mission's average of each vital and compares it to the new data and calculates the difference between the new data and the average of the mission. The data is also analyzed using graphs which shows the daily changes and help in forming a trend which helps to predict future changes and helps in making preventive action.

The main benefits of the program is the storage of old data , comparing new data to the old data to find the difference and avg and the graphing ability that makes trends and helps in analysis.

Intended impact of the program is to help the astronaut maintain his health by checking easy to check vitals , collect the data and build a trend and take preventive action that helps the mission to sail smoothly.

I used VS-code as the IDE , C++ as the coding language , used octave to make the graphs and used git/git hub for documentation.

Instead of having a simple questionnaire the program stores the data daily , compares new data to old data and graph the problems.

I kept in mind to keep that the vitals that the astronaut is checking are simple and easy to check in the circumstances that the astronaut is in.
